verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a hardware FIDO2/passkey security key, and its design centres on requiring a physical touch to confirm each operation. Setting up autonomous background automations is not a capability this kind of product would ship. The evidence shows only a management CLI (list, update, LED settings) and firmware-building tools, none of which is an automation or scheduling feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
